notes: Descriptions are based on the current 1.21.1 branch source and public README.

features.name: Unlock and morph progression
features.description: Players unlock supported identities and morph into them.
examples: Kill an entity to unlock it when kill-based unlocks are enabled.

features.name: Identity selection menu
features.description: Client menu supports search, filters, previews, and variant selection.

features.name: Variant-aware morphs
features.description: Selected morph variants are stored and reapplied so visuals match the chosen form.

features.name: Identity abilities
features.description: Morphs can use built-in or datapack-defined abilities.

features.name: Generic fallback ability
features.description: Morphs without a specific ability can fall back to a generic active ability path.
notes: Current code uses fallback ability resolution for supported morphable identities.

features.name: Shape and health sync
features.description: Morphs sync collision size, eye height, and optional health scaling.

features.name: Charges and soul jars
features.description: The mod includes morph charges, soul jar storage, and permanent morph progression settings.

features.name: Runtime config commands
features.description: Admins can query and edit supported config keys through commands.

features.name: Villager trade interaction
features.description: Players morphed as villager-type identities can trigger trade interactions.

features.name: Addon integration API
features.description: Public API exists for built-in abilities, variant adapters, and morph tick hooks.
